Overview Triple Core is the bridge between global networking manufacturers and local telecom and networking companies. For infrastructure projects that means one supplier for switching, routing, wireless and the accessories that hold it all together — with genuine stock, not grey imports. We are an Authorized Reseller for Mikrotik, Ubiquiti, RF Elements, MaxLink and Masterlan, and we also supply Cudy, Ruijie, Mimosa, D-Link, Huawei, Yealink, Yeastar and Mercusys. Every product is backed by a warranty and RMA process: if a part fails, we inspect it, confirm the fault, and replace it. Key Features Managed & unmanaged switches — Including PoE and outdoor-rated models for edge, access and distribution layers. Access points, mesh & extenders — Indoor and outdoor wireless coverage for workspaces, warehouses, yards, and whole-premises connectivity where full cabling isn't practical. Ethernet and fiber routers — 10/100 and Gigabit routing platforms for offices, sites and service delivery. Point-to-Point & Point-to-Multipoint links — Wireless backhaul and distribution links for connecting buildings, sites, and remote locations without fiber.
